title: Continuity of affine one-bit power means
statement: For every real $s>0$, the function of $a\in\mathbb R$ given by the uniform power mean of $x\mapsto 1+a\sigma(x_0)$ on the one-dimensional Boolean cube is continuous; explicitly, it is $\bigl(\frac12\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}}|1+a\sigma(x_0)|^s\bigr)^{1/s}$, where $\sigma(0)=1$ and $\sigma(1)=-1$.
replaced: For every $s>0$, the map $a\mapsto(\E_{t\in\{0,1\}}|1+a(-1)^t|^s)^{1/s}$ is continuous on $\bbr$.
